newsitem.title: FRANCE: Climate favourable to growth - Trichet quoted.
newsitem.headline: Climate favourable to growth - Trichet quoted.

text.p: The economic environment should be favourable to growth in 1997 and should encourage business investment, Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet was quoted on Thursday as telling a parliamentary committee.
Trichet attended the hearing, of the parliament's finance committee, on Wednesday.

"He said that the climate would be favourable objectively to economic growth in 1997 and should translate into positive investment decisions by business leaders," the minutes, released on Thursday, quoted him as saying.

"He said that our country's monetary competitiveness was good. In this respect, he stressed the surpluses in our trade balance, and said that recent movements, notably of the dollar, should improve this even more," the minutes said.
